lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"You mean, if we[01]follow this, we can[01]get to the mainland?[02][14][81]ARight, Poko?"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][C1]@"Voce quer dizer que se[01]seguirmos isso, chegamos[01]ao continente?[02][14][81]ACerto, Poko?"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Heh heh...[02]She says we will be[01]in a great deal of[02]trouble should the[01]sun go down before[01]we reach land."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Heh heh...[02]Ela diz que teremos[01]muita encrenca se o[02]sol se por antes de[01]chegarmos em[01]terra firme."

lines.text_source: [14][03][01]"Uh-oh! It's getting[01]dark!"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][04][03]"This isn't good...[01]It's getting dark."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][05][04]"Looks like we'd[01]better hurry."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][87]A"Hmmm..."[02][14][C1]@"Looks like this is[01]as far as we can get[01]today."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][C2]@"Drat! It's too dark[01]to even see the path.[02]Guess we're stuck[01]here until morning."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][02][14][C2]@"Droga! Escuro demais[01]pra ver o caminho.[02]Parece que ficamos[01]aqui ate amanha."

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][C4]@"It's too dark. We[01]should stop here and[01]wait until morning."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][02][14][C4]@"Escuro demais. Vamos[01]parar aqui e esperar[01]ate amanha."

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][C5]@"[04][05] tells me..."[02][14][86]E"It's too dark to[01]continue--looks like[01]we're stuck here."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][02][14][C5]@"[04][05] me diz..."[02][14][86]E"Escuro demais pra[01]continuar -- parece[01]que ficamos aqui."

lines.text_source: [14][85]D"I wonder how much[01]further we have to[01]go?"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][C2]@"We can't afford[01]to waste our time[02]sitting around like[01]this!"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][C2]@"I guess you're[01]right..."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][09][04]"We shouldn't have[01]stopped![02]We should've kept[01]going through the[01]night,[02]no matter how risky[01]it was!"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][09][04]"Nao deveriamos ter[01]parado![02]Deveriamos ter[01]continuado a noite[01]toda,[02]por mais arriscado[01]que fosse!"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][8A]A"I'm sorry, [04][02].[01]It's my fault...[02]If I hadn't suggested[01]we rest for the[01]night..."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][8A]A"Me desculpe, [04][02].[01]A culpa e minha...[02]Se eu nao tivesse[01]sugerido que[01]descansassemos..."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C1]@"C-come on! Let's[01]do as she says!"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][C4]@"Judging by the lay[01]of the land, I'd say[02]this is where the[01]flats connect to the[01]mainland."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][C4]@"Pelo terreno, eu diria[01]que e aqui que as[02]planicies se ligam[01]ao continente."

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][C4]@"It's no use...[02]We can't go this way[01]either."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][C4]@"Nao adianta...[02]Tambem nao da pra[01]ir por aqui."

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][04][03]"Until the tide[01]changes and the flats[01]reappear...[02]We're stuck here."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][04][03]"Ate a mare mudar[01]e as planicies[01]voltarem...[02]Ficamos presos aqui."

lines.text_source: [14][05][04]"How can you be so[01]calm!?"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][86]E"Chill out, [04][02]![02]We'll get out of[01]here--you can count[01]on it.[02]Remember, [04]
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][86]E"At the very least,[01][04]
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][07][01]"Well, we weren't[01]exactly expecting[02]something like this[01]to happen, but...[02][14][01][01]I'm sure everything[01]will work out in the[01]end."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][07][01]"Bom, nao era bem[01]isso que a gente[02]esperava, mas...[02][14][01][01]Tenho certeza que[01]tudo vai dar certo[01]no final."

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"Are you going off[01]to explore the[01]island?[02]I hope you don't mind[01]if I come with you!"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][04][03]"Calm down![02]Get a hold of[01]yourself."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][04][03]"You're supposed to[01]be the leader of this[02]little expedition,[01]aren't you!?"[02][14][0D][08]...[0B]...[0B]..."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][03][14][86]E"Remember what the[01]Pabpab said?[02]Pukapuka...What will[01]be, will be...[02]That's a good lesson[01]to learn, pretty[01]kitty..."[02][14][C5]@"Indeed."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][03][14][86]E"Lembra o que o[01]Pabpab disse?[02]Pukapuka...O que for,[01]sera...[02]Uma boa licao pra[01]aprender, gatinha[01]linda..."[02][14][C5]@"De fato."

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][C1]@"We were just talking[01]about going to look[01]for some food."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][06][05]"Well, I suppose[01]there are a lot worse[01]places to get stuck."[02][14]E
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][06][05]"Bom, ja fui parar[01]em lugar pior do[01]que esse."[02][14]E

lines.text_source: [14][0E][01]"I guess this means[01]you can fish around[01]here...Right?"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][0E][01]"Isso quer dizer que[01]da pra pescar[01]por aqui... Ne?"

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Were you able to[01]catch anything,[01][04]
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][07][01]"Well, that means we[01]don't have to worry[01]about food then."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][01][01]"We should go back[01]and tell everyone[01]what we found."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Vamos voltar e contar[01]pra todo mundo o[01]que achamos."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C2]@"That's good...[02]I'm sorry, [04][01].[01]I don't know what[01]happened...[02]It's just...When I[01]thought we were[01]trapped here,[02]I just...I don't[01]know, I panicked..."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C2]@"Que bom...[02]Desculpe, [04][01].[01]Nao sei o que[01]deu em mim...[02]E que...Quando pensei[01]que estavamos[01]presos,[02]eu so...Nao sei,[01]entrei em panico..."

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Don't worry, [04][02].[01]We just have to be[01]patient, that's all."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Nao se preocupe, [04][02].[01]So precisamos ter[01]paciencia, so isso."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][01][01]"[04][02], we're going[01]fishing. We'll be[01]back soon!"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][05][04]"What will be, will[01]be, huh?...[0B]..."
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][87]A"I always figured[01]they would get[01]married someday...[02][14][81]AHe's been like a[01]brother to me..."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][87]A"Sempre achei que[01]eles iam se casar[01]um dia...[02][14][81]AEle e como um[01]irmao pra mim..."

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"I think maybe...I[01]look up to him more[01]than love him..."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][C1]@"Acho que eu...[01]o admiro mais do[01]que o amo..."

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"I mean, he's[01]strong...[02]There's nothing he[01]can't do...He's[01]funny..."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][C1]@"Ele e forte...[01]Nao tem nada que[02]ele nao consiga...[01]E engracado..."

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"It looks like it's[01]going out.[02]Let's go see!"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][06][05]"See? I told you we[01]just had to be[01]patient."[02][14]E
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][06][05]"Ta vendo? Eu disse[01]que so precisavamos[01]ter paciencia."[02][14]E
